description: This Java class enforces size restrictions on JSON data related to 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto project, particularly for indexing purposes. It manages length constraints, encodes JSON values, and calculates overhead for indexing keys.

classes.name: IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer
classes.description: A utility class to enforce maximum length restrictions on JSON index entries, including handling string encoding and size calculations.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer for a given thing ID.

methods.name: enforce
methods.description: Enforces size restrictions on a JSON value based on its pointer and content, possibly truncating string values.

methods.name: fixViolation
methods.description: Truncates a JSON string value to fit within size limits, encoding it in UTF-8.

methods.name: calculateThingIdNamespaceAuthSubjectOverhead
methods.description: Calculates overhead size based on the thing ID, including namespace and authorization overhead.

methods.name: jsonPointerBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte size of a JSON pointer when encoded in UTF-8.

methods.name: checkThingId
methods.description: Validates that the thing ID is non-null and non-empty.
